work_scope.capability: Room source, Player Embodiment and Physics Glyph panel tests
work_scope.required_evidence: Existing panel suites and scoped compiler
work_scope.explicit_non_goals: No production behavior, authority, game action, physical validation or installed acceptance changes

review: Player Embodiment fixtures now implement the existing complete environment and source-binding contracts instead of casting incomplete objects to never. The identity assignment uses supported, an existing valid contract value; all action authority remains separate.

Room source receipt fixtures accept the existing environment projection contract, allowing different IDs, adapters and stale identities. Variant fixtures use satisfies instead of deeply readonly literal types.

Testing Library role queries retain exact accessible-name strings without the unsupported exact option. The legacy contact-scenario test explicitly verifies its v1 discriminator before accessing states; other scenario versions remain supported.
All 42 existing tests passed before the changes. This is test-contract correction, not a reproduced runtime defect. Three production panel files are selected unchanged for export verification.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished and uninstalled. These synthetic panel tests do not establish real room membership, pairing, streaming, game execution, or Physics Glyph proof integrity.
Export tests load the three selected production panels from the preview; remaining dependencies use canonical bytes.
